title: devstack project (devstack.yaml)
description: One repo's devstack.yaml — the portable project layer: services rendered from templates, the shared services they consume, declarative data-plane resources, lifecycle hooks and the task graph. Hand-authored per DECISIONS D16; the Go validator in internal/config is the source of truth and a CI round-trip test keeps the two aligned.

name.description: Project name. Must match the name workspace.yaml lists for this path.

services.description: Containers in this project's stack, keyed by service name.

resources.description: Declarative data-plane resources this project needs INSIDE a shared engine (spec 27). Provisioned idempotently by `up`. Removing an entry never auto-drops the resource — teardown is always explicit.

tasks.description: The non-container task graph run by `devstack run` (spec 31).

dsname.description: Compose/DNS-safe identifier: lowercase, starts with a letter, up to 63 chars of [a-z0-9_-].

cpus.description: Fractional cores as a string, e.g. "1.5". Must be greater than zero.

platform.description: An os/arch[/variant] selector, e.g. linux/amd64, linux/arm64/v8.

envMap.description: Literal environment variables. Values support ${env.NAME}, ${self.attr}, ${ref:...}, ${profile} and ${workspace.name} interpolation, plus secret://provider/path#key refs.

params.description: Template parameters. Accepted keys and types are declared by the template's params: block (see `devstack template list --json`).

resources.title: Resource limits
resources.description: CPU/memory/PID limits (spec 18). Lowered to BOTH deploy.resources.limits.* and the legacy top-level cpus/mem_limit/pids_limit.

memoryReserveMB.description: Soft memory reservation in MB (scheduling hint).

hook.title: Lifecycle hook
hook.description: One declarative command run at a saga phase (spec 11).

run.description: host runs via os/exec on the host; exec shells into a running service with `compose exec -T`.

service.description: Target service. Required when run: exec.

command.description: argv array — never shell-split by devstack.

once.description: Run at most once per workspace (firstRun ledger).

hooks.title: Lifecycle hooks
hooks.description: Hooks grouped by saga phase (spec 11). Lists REPLACE on overlay merge unless the YAML opts into `$merge: append`.

service.title: Service
service.description: One container in the project stack, rendered from a template.

template.description: Template ref, e.g. node.next, php.laravel.nginx. See `devstack template list`.

uses.description: Shared services this service consumes, as workspace.shared.<name>.

memoryMB.description: Shorthand for resources.memoryMB; also feeds the workspace memory budget.

env.title: Environment
env.description: Container environment. raw/prefixed are literal (with ${...} interpolation); import pulls exported vars from another service.

from.description: Reference path, e.g. workspace.shared.postgres or workspace.<project>.<service>.

vars.description: Exported attribute names to import. Omit for all exports.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Readiness probe (spec 10). Compiles to both a Compose healthcheck: block and a tool-side prober.

expectStatus.description: http/https only: "200" or a range like "200-399".

command.description: exec kind: argv; exit 0 means healthy.

auth.description: redis only; may be a secret:// ref.

dependsOn.title: Ordering edge
dependsOn.description: A readiness-ordering edge (spec 10). A healthy edge requires the target to declare a healthcheck.

service.description: An intra-project service name, or workspace.shared.<name>.

uses.description: The shared engine that hosts this resource.

name.description: Engine-level identifier. Defaults to the project name.

engine.description: Optional; inferred from the uses target's template.

task.title: Task
task.description: One node in the task graph (spec 31). A short-lived command, not a container.

command.description: argv array — never shell-split by devstack.

deps.description: Task names that must complete first. Cycles are rejected at run time.

watch.description: Long-running dev-server task that --watch keeps alive.
